a2_policy: fusion/LFA raw tensors remain SHA-bound and replayable but do not enter PCA coordinates; their scalar summaries enter R2 directly
pca_core_layout: first 450 coordinates (final_fused=300, shared_fused=150) plus final 100 coordinates per active modality (specific=50, aligned_shared=50)
raw_artifact_layout: final_fused, shared_fused, replayable A2 fusion/LFA blocks, then one specific+aligned-shared pair per active modality
reason: avoid padded time-coordinate and sequence-length shortcuts while retaining all head-driving A1 representations
